description:
Use this when you need an auditable Bangladesh working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when government/public-office schedule only; private-employer, bank, school, industrial-zone, essential-service, regional hill-district, optional-religious and later unlisted ad hoc schedules are not inferred. February 10 is not included because the reported later holiday was industrial-zone specific. Lunar dates may be revised by a later official notice.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Bangladesh working days around Election-period special holiday. | Count Bangladesh working days around Eid-ul-Adha period.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-03-19","end_date":"2026-03-23","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/bangladesh-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/bangladesh-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_bd_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Bangladesh 2026 government public-office holiday schedule plus later election-period national closures

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Bangladesh Working Days
